spec.name: sprint47_taker_imbalance_extreme_btceth
spec.hypothesis: Extreme 1m-aggregated taker buy/sell imbalance (top/bottom 5% of trailing 7d distribution) predicts same-direction BTC/ETH return over the next 30 minutes beyond round-trip costs, via persistent aggressive order flow.
spec.power_argument: Expected validation trades >=300 (2 symbols, trigger ~5% tails de-clustered, cap 6 entries/day per symbol over validation window). 30m return SD ~30-35bps (assumed, to be measured in train window); SE at n=300 ~2bps; min detectable net edge ~6bps at t>=3. Fail if mean net <=0 or t<3; null (no edge) yields failure with high probability, so criteria can fail.
